about.title: 01 - About me
about.description: I have 5 years of experience in web application development, including more than 4 years on projects for companies such as Leroy Merlin, Camaïeu, and the Imprimerie Nationale. Specialised in Vue.js, Nuxt, and TypeScript, I work on new feature development, business applications, and the modernization of existing front-end systems. My personal experience with NestBudget also led me to take ownership of a SaaS product from concept through to production release.

projects.name: Tabletop GM Notebook
projects.description: A web app for tabletop role-playing game masters. It prepares a session in one place: summary, key points to remember, ambiance playlist, and a reusable NPC library from one session to the next. Vue 3, Vite, Vue Router — architecture designed around a two-entity data model (sessions / shared NPCs).
